text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I know! Why don't we line up the one I won 
and the one you won side by side in the 
Trainer's office?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Like medals we won together. I'm sure 
it'll become a wonderful memory!"
